episodes.208128: The James river near Stratford, having crested in August, dropped below flood stage during the early morning hours of October 20th.
episodes.208355: An area of gusty showers over the Everglades produced funnel cloud activity on the afternoon of October 1, 2025.

events.narrative: The James River remained above flood stage from the beginning of the month until the early morning hours of October 20th. This was a continuation of flooding that began in August.
Public reported a brief funnel cloud associated with an area of gusty showers over the Everglades in SW Miami Dade.
